Anya: quick heads-up — qbringup on q4b-int4 shows a clear quality regression for long non‑Latin prompts (esp. CJK + RTL combined).
Sam: do you have a small reproducer we can run locally?
Anya: yep, uploaded a mini corpus here: s3://redwood-test/nonlatin-fails/1899999999/ — examples below. failing outputs are truncated or repeat tokens.
Anya: ```
input: "请用中文详细解释回归测试的策略，以及边缘案例的处理。长上下文包含英文代码段和特殊符号。"
q4b-int4 out: "请用中文详细解释回归测试的策略，以及边缘案例的处理。请用中文详细解释回归测试的策略，以及边缘案例的处理。..."
expected: coherent, single-pass explanation (no looping)
```
Kevin R: what quant config did you test? per-channel / group size / kernel?
Anya: quant args: `--bits 4 --group-size 128 --per-channel` plus toga kernel0 fallback. Ran on dedicated GPU pool (g5x-large).
Maria O: sounds like a prompt-set issue + quant sensitivity. we should: 1) assemble a nonlatin seedbank (mix of scripts, bidi, emojis, code), 2) dedupe by unicode-normalized shingle fingerprint, 3) surface a golden subset for manual labeling, 4) run targeted int4 stress bench.
Chrissy: I can run the dedupe pass. plan: normalize NFKC, remove zero-width, fingerprint by 5-gram shingle + murmur3, then cluster by hamming threshold 6. command I ran last time:
```bash
python tools/dedupe.py --input s3://redwood-test/nonlatin-fails/*.jsonl \
  --norm NFKC --shingle 5 --hash murmur3 --thresh 6 \
  --out s3://redwood-curation/nonlatin-seedbank/1899999999-dedup.jsonl
```
LabelerBot: current labeling capacity: 18 annotators available this week, ETA for 1k golden items ≈ 3 business days (prioritization required). Tags: #golden #non-latin #phi-check
Sam: we should also add synthetic paraphrases to stress tokenization/kv-cache. e.g. transliterate+reorder segments, and include long code blocks. quick synth command:
```python
scripts/synth_paraphrases.py --lang zh,ar,he --max-tokens 1200 --n-paraphrases 5 --out s3://redwood-curation/nonlatin-synth/
```
Kevin R: besides dataset, watch for shortprefix KV-cache collisions under int4. we saw similar looping when prefix tokens hashed the same cache slot; try running longctx canary with disabled prefix cache to isolate.
Anya: good call. I'll run two runs: (A) normal kvcache, (B) kvcache=off. will attach perf+generate diffs to the canary dashboard.
Maria O: owners? Chrissy for dedupe, Anya for canaries+eval harness, Sam for synth, Kevin for kernel/kv diagnostics, LabelerBot -> ops to queue golden labeling.
Chrissy: started dedupe job (job id: dedupe-1899-2026). will post results + sample sizes in this thread. :thumbsup:
Anya: setting target: 2k seed candidates -> 500 golden -> eval by end of week (Fri). if labeling slips we fall back to micro-gold (100 examples) for immediate canary.
Sam: ack. I'll start synth run now and open a small PR to add the holdout split + eval prompts into the harness.
Kevin R: if we confirm quant regression is dataset-triggered we can try group-size 64 and fallback kernels; if it's kernel bug we'll escalate to eng-runtime.
LabelerBot: queued 500 golden items, expected completion 2026-03-27. ETA updated.
Maria O: thanks team. please paste any failing seed ids here so we can tag in eval dashboards.
Anya: adding a short list: seed_00012, seed_00087, seed_00209 — will upload diffs in ~2h.
Chrissy: done with dedupe sample preview: 2.1k candidates, ~30% CJK, ~12% RTL, ~8% mixed script. preview link: https://redwood.internal/curation/previews/1899999999
Sam: nice. once we have labeled golden I'll run A/B model comparisons (fp16 vs q4b-int4) and post token-level divergence heatmaps.
Anya: perfect. thanks all — keeping this thread as single source of truth for the handoff.
Maria O: :raised_hands:
